results.releaseNotes:
Write a character by hand when its pronunciation escapes you, or speak to turn your thoughts into text. This update gives you more ways to express yourself with DDUP.

• Handwriting and Zhuyin: Two new keyboards let you type your way. Draw a Chinese character to enter it, even when you don't know how to pronounce it.
• Your words, in your keyboard: Import custom dictionaries and contact names to make names, specialist terms, and everyday phrases easier to type.
• Say what comes to mind: Upgraded in-keyboard voice input supports on-device recognition and downloadable offline models for conversations and quick notes.
• Quick Text, a tap away: Saved phrases and clipboard history now live together. Keep addresses, replies, and recently copied text close at hand.
• Smoother Pinyin input: An updated Wanxiang Pinyin dictionary and emoji suggestions, improved letter selection with a long press on the 9-key layout, a new Retype action, and quick switching between number layouts.
• Switch the language you learn: Choose your candidate translation language right from the home screen and build vocabulary as you type.
• More room on iPad: DDUP now supports iPad, with a split layout for learning on wider screens and word books and themes that adapt to the screen width.
results.description:
Learn new words as you type.

Share how you feel, plan your next trip, or talk about a great meal. The Chinese you type can be the starting point for learning another language.

DDUP shows translations above Chinese word candidates, bringing new vocabulary into familiar conversations. Save words as you go and make them stick with regular practice.

【Learn from the words you use every day】
Choose from English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Italian, and Russian. See translations as you type and build your vocabulary around what you actually say.

【Find a word. Save it for later.】
Enable candidate gestures to swipe down to save a word or up to send its translation. Save words from dictionary results, explore and download word books, and organize your collection in folders.

【Turn new words into familiar ones】
Learn and review with multiple-choice questions and self-assessment. Practice new words and revisit those due for review at your own pace. Track your progress with learning trends, a calendar, and daily streaks.

【Listen on your commute or a walk】
Play words aloud and get familiar with their pronunciation. Make the most of spare moments and let repeated listening bring vocabulary to life.

【Type the way that feels right】
Choose full Pinyin, a 9-key layout, Double Pinyin, Wubi, stroke input, or an English keyboard, plus handwriting and Zhuyin input. Import Sogou dictionaries, text dictionaries, and contact names to make names and specialist terms easier to type.

【Your everyday phrases, a tap away】
Keep saved phrases and clipboard history together in Quick Text. Insert replies, addresses, and frequently used information, or use in-keyboard voice input to turn your thoughts into text.

【Make every keystroke your own】
Choose themes, fonts, keyboard badges, and typing effects, or import your own fonts. Customize haptics, key sounds, character pop-ups, and cursor control with a slide of the spacebar.

Start with your first message today. Type familiar Chinese with DDUP and discover new words.

【Subscription Cancellation Info】
1. Subscriptions auto-renew; payment is charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
2. The system automatically charges your account and extends membership by one month within 24 hours prior to the current period's expiration.
3. To cancel, please manually disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. 4. Cancellation steps: Open iPhone "Settings" > Go to "iTunes Store & App Store" > Tap "Apple ID" > Select "View Apple ID" > Tap "Subscriptions" under "Account Settings" > Find and cancel the "continuous subscription."
